# Deuteronomy 32:8

Hansam Yang · Hansam Bible · v0.1.0

AI-assisted translation draft · specialist and native-language review pending

This is a research draft. It does not claim discovery of an autograph or a complete reconstruction of the earliest text.

The display is MT. Its ‘sons of Israel’ is distinguished from the ‘sons of God’ reading reported for 4Q37. This page does not establish the exact earliest wording.

Basis: MT-WLC display, with a separately labelled reported 4Q37 variant

Decision: Open — full independent collation and direct image review pending

## 8 · HYB.DEUT.032.008

Hebrew display (MT/WLC): בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

When the Most High assigned inheritances to nations, when he divided humankind, he set the boundaries of peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

sons of God

## Notes

Emanuel Tov’s 2023 comparison distinguishes MT/SP ‘sons of Israel’ from 4Q37 ‘sons of God’. This is his published evidence report, not a new reading of a manuscript photograph by this project.

Ancient Greek witnesses also differ. A translation cannot automatically establish one exact Hebrew antecedent. Preservation of a variant phrase is distinct from preservation of the whole verse.

Counter-check: the Israel tradition must also be evaluated; an older artifact alone does not settle priority. The decision remains Open pending direct reading, independence and translation-technique checks.
